ItemID: NA; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have enjoyed Christmas music, but I am looking for relaxing everyday listening right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Something Beautiful; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not give me enough reason to expect the classical or theatrical sound I enjoy.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Pentatonix Christmas; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would save this for a holiday listening mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: PTX, Vol. 2; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Contemporary vocal arrangements are less appealing to me right now than gentle orchestral or classical crossover music.
ItemID: NA; Title: Dream With Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its classical crossover vocals fit my interest in expressive singing and relaxing accompaniment.
ItemID: NA; Title: Home for Christmas; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Christmas music fits part of my history, but it is not what I would choose this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Awakening; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The classical crossover style appeals to the same taste that draws me to Stages and Under One Sky.
ItemID: NA; Title: How Can It Be; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Contemporary worship music is not a strong match for my current interest in classical and theatrical listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: Welcome to the New; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its contemporary Christian pop direction is not what I am seeking on this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Celtic Thunder Christmas; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The vocal ensemble is appealing, but I would wait until I wanted seasonal music.
